title: Half capital in a 2x Taiwan 50 with the other half in T-bills or gold, rebalanced yearly, cut 0050's worst drawdown from −34% to −26–27% in 2014–2026; without rebalancing it rose to −50%
question: Does 50% in a 2x Taiwan 50 product plus 50% in T-bills, gold or cash lower drawdown against 100% 0050, and at what return?
hypothesis: Keeping the Taiwan exposure through 2x on half the capital and holding an uncorrelated asset with the other half lowers drawdown.

findings.title: Every barbell lowered the worst drawdown — with yearly rebalancing
findings.detail: 2014–2026: 0050 −33.83%; 2x + T-bills −26.28%, 2x + gold −27.49%, 2x + gold + T-bills −25.91%; same ordering on the real 00631L from 2016.
findings.title_zh: 每年調回時，每個組合都降低了最大回檔

findings.title: Without rebalancing it is worse than 0050
findings.detail: The 2x share drifts up and max drawdown reaches −49.6% to −52.4% (synthetic 2x, 2014–) and −45.1% to −52.0% (real 00631L, 2016–).
findings.title_zh: 不調回比單抱 0050 更糟

findings.title: Plain 0050 + gold lowers drawdown most
findings.detail: −17.40% at 16.73% CAGR against 0050's −33.83% at 21.38%: less drawdown for less return, no leverage.
findings.title_zh: 不用槓桿的 0050＋黃金回檔最小

findings.title: One favourable path
findings.detail: Taiwan equities and gold both rose strongly; 0050's worst fall in the sample was −34%, TAIEX's in 2008 was −58%, where a 2x falls about −85%.
findings.detail_zh: 台股和黃金都大漲；樣本中 0050 最大跌 34%，加權在 2008 年跌 58%，正二在那種情況約跌 85%。

card_summary: With yearly rebalancing, half the capital in a 2x Taiwan 50 and half in T-bills or gold cut the worst drawdown from −34% to −26–27% while keeping the Taiwan exposure (2014–2026). Without rebalancing it reached −50%. 0050 + gold without leverage cut it most, to −17%, at a lower return.
title_zh: 半數資金正二＋半數美國公債或黃金，每年調回，2014–2026 年把 0050 的最大回檔從 −34% 降到 −26–27%；不調回則升到 −50%
question_zh: 用一半資金買正二維持台股曝險，另一半放美國短期公債、黃金或現金，能不能比全部買 0050 回檔小？報酬代價多少？
hypothesis_zh: 正二保留台股曝險，另一半放低相關資產，可以降低回檔。
card_summary_zh: 每年調回比例時，半數正二＋半數公債或黃金，在保留台股曝險下把最大回檔從 −34% 降到 −26–27%（2014–2026）。不調回則達 −50%。不用槓桿的 0050＋黃金回檔最小（−17%），但報酬較低。
limitations_zh: 單一 12.8 年路徑，台股與黃金都大漲。
以 0050 合成正二（比 00631L 略樂觀）；真實 00631L 從 2016 年開始。
樣本中沒有 2008 年等級的崩盤（見 RS-TX-20261018-004）。
公債以 ^IRX 計息；黃金為 XAUUSD 現貨；匯率去除兩筆錯誤報價；紐約收盤延後一個台股交易日對齊。
未計交易成本以外的稅。
interpretation_zh: 一半資金買正二保留台股曝險，另一半放美國公債或黃金，每年調回比例，2014–2026 年最大回檔從 −34% 降到約 −26–27%，報酬沒有變差。關鍵是每年調回：不調回時正二比重越來越大，回檔反而到 −50%。這段期間台股和黃金都大漲，沒有 2008 年等級的崩盤，見 RS-TX-20261018-004。
